note: This is a decomposition PLAN over the current open scope, not an adoption decision. Unit progress comes only from verified observation (see decomposition/baseline output); recollection is never recorded as progress. Each unit declares a single owning worktree; no two units mutate one worktree concurrently. The dependency graph is directed and acyclic. Integration is gated on green acceptance plus integrated declared dependencies.

units.title: Mac first-stage: keep Neovim as editing engine, render external UI via GLSL

acceptance.witness: offscreen --snapshot renders a real Neovim 0.11.5 grid through OpenGL 4.1; GPU probe is Apple M4 Max, not software fallback

units.title: macOS IME connected end to end: preedit distinct from committed value

acceptance.witness: logged sequence IME: enabled -> preedit -> commit; preedit is drawn inverted at caret and is not written into the buffer until commit

units.title: Commence aish integration as read-only typed-object surface

acceptance.witness: :AishDiscover/:AishStatus/:AishInspect return structured JSON into a scratch buffer; no aish run/exec, no confirmation bypass; counterpart repo observed PRIVATE at commencement

units.title: Root-ui combination hypothesis: emit framework-neutral text-editing-host projection

acceptance.witness: --root-ui-evaluation writes machine-readable projection recording zero React footprint, replaceable framework-neutral text-editing host port, semantic->layout->non-color-decoration->user-color->shader phase order

units.title: Multi-target portability direction: cross-platform winit/glutin + replaceable font discovery

acceptance.witness: --platform-report writes actual OS/arch/GL renderer/GLSL/Neovim version and marks the Rust/OpenGL/winit stack as non-canonical; font discovery accepts NVIMGL_FONT_PATHS plus replaceable OS candidates
